Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +3 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Super Class allies' ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Attacks are effective against all Types
- Great chance of stunning the attacked enemy
*When there is another "Majin Buu Saga" or "Earthlings" Category
ally attacking in the same turn*
- Chance of performing a critical hit, damage reduction rate &
chance of evading enemy's attack 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches 2 additional attacks, each of which has a great chance
of becoming a Super Attack
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every Super Attack performed*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g} within the turn
*After performing 3 or more Super Attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}Foresees enemy's Super Attack within the character's
attacking turn from the next turn onward
*After performing 6 or more Super Attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every turn passed*
- {passiveImg:forever}"Majin Buu Saga" or "Earthlings" Category allies' ATK &
DEF 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 100%), plus Ki +1 (up to +10) for characters who
are also Super Class, within the character's attacking turn
*Starting from the 10th turn from the character's entry turn*
- Can nullify attacks that are guaranteed to hit, making it possible
to evade these attacks
- "Majin Buu Saga" or "Earthlings" Category allies' Ki +3,
plus attacks are effective against all Types for characters
who are also Super Class

9192.superDescription:
Greatly raises ATK & DEF for 1 turn, 
causes supreme damage to enemy 
and greatly lowers ATK & DEF
